flowauto.say: Flow Auto is a Chrome and Edge extension that turns a scene-by-scene script into finished, numbered, ten-eighty p videos on Google Flow.
flowauto.text: Flow Auto is a Chrome and Edge extension that turns a scene-by-scene script into finished, numbered, 1080p videos on Google Flow.

flowauto.say: Paste a ChatGPT script, or Jason. Scenes, batches and global rules are checked before you accept them.
flowauto.text: Paste a ChatGPT script, or JSON. Scenes, batches and global rules are checked before you accept them.

flowauto.say: It makes storyboards and character sheets with Flow, ChatGPT, Grok or Meta AI, and saves them as real P N G files.
flowauto.text: It makes storyboards and character sheets with Flow, ChatGPT, Grok or Meta AI, and saves them as real PNG files.

flowauto.say: Each scene goes to Flow, in Standard or Agent mode, or to Grok Imagine, with its rules and references attached.
flowauto.text: Each scene goes to Flow, in Standard or Agent mode, or to Grok Imagine, with its rules and references attached.

flowauto.say: Flow Auto uses Google Flow's own ten-eighty p upscale, then saves every file as one, two, three, and so on, checked for the exact name and resolution.
flowauto.text: Flow Auto uses Google Flow's own 1080p upscale, then saves every file as 1, 2, 3, and so on, checked for the exact name and resolution.

flowauto.say: Global rules and character descriptions go into every image and video prompt, so batches stay consistent.
flowauto.text: Global rules and character descriptions go into every image and video prompt, so batches stay consistent.

flowauto.say: The queue survives a refresh or a crash without making duplicates. And when a result is unclear, it pauses for your choice instead of guessing.
